examples.code:
<Block display="flex" flexDirection="column" gap="4">
  <DateTimeInput
    label="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm (default)"
    defaultValue={new Date(2026, 4, 30, 13, 45)}
    mobileNative={false}
  />
  <DateTimeInput
    label="MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm A"
    format="MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm A"
    defaultValue={new Date(2026, 4, 30, 13, 45)}
    mobileNative={false}
  />
  <DateTimeInput
    label="DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm"
    format="DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm"
    defaultValue={new Date(2026, 4, 30, 13, 45)}
    mobileNative={false}
  />
  <DateTimeInput
    label="Intl — display only"
    format={{ dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }}
    editable={false}
    defaultValue={new Date(2026, 4, 30, 13, 45)}
    mobileNative={false}
  />
</Block>

accessibility:
- Trigger uses `role="combobox"` with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-controls`.
- Popover panel has `role="dialog"` with an accessible name.
- Calendar uses `role="grid"`; cells expose `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled`, and `aria-current="date"`.
- Each time wheel uses `role="spinbutton"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, `aria-valuenow`, and `aria-valuetext`.
- The footer's confirm button exposes an accessible label (`Done`); the Reset button reverts your edits to the value the popover opened with.
- Tab order naturally walks from calendar → time wheels → footer (Reset / ✓).
summary: The `DateTimeInput` combines a calendar and a time **wheel spinner** in a single popover — an iOS-style layout.

parts.summary: The `DateTimeInput` combines a calendar and a time **wheel spinner** in a single popover — an iOS-style layout.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label. Automatically associated with the input via `htmlFor` — uses your `id` when provided, otherwise a generated one. Not wired in `inline` mode (no visible input to label) and dropped inside an outer `Field`.

props.name: labelSize
props.description: Size for the label.

props.name: labelProps
props.description: Props for the label element. An explicit `htmlFor` here overrides the automatic association (no id is generated then).

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Render the field with horizontal layout.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: Icon props for the left icon.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: Icon props for the right icon.

props.name: iconRightName
props.description: Shortcut for the right icon name.

props.name: iconLeftSize
props.description: Shortcut for left icon size.

props.name: iconRightSize
props.description: Shortcut for right icon size.

props.name: hasIconsLeft
props.description: Force the left icon container.

props.name: hasIconsRight
props.description: Force the right icon container.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show a loading indicator on the control.

props.name: isExpanded
props.description: Expand the control to fill its container.

props.name: controlSize
props.description: Size of the wrapping Control.

props.name: message
props.description: Help/validation text below the input.

props.name: messageColor
props.description: Message color.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Field wrapper.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the Control wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected date-time.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fired when either the date or time portion changes.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when the popover opens.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Fired when the popover closes.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound for the combined date-time.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound for the combined date-time.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Read-only input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text.

props.name: format
props.description: Token format string or `Intl.DateTimeFormat` options. Default `'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'`.

props.name: parse
props.description: Custom parser.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale tag.

props.name: inline
props.description: Render the panel inline (no popover).

props.name: mobileNative
props.description: Use `<input type="datetime-local">` on coarse-pointer devices.

props.name: editable
props.description: Allow segmented keyboard typing (type the date-time directly across all segments). `false` makes the field picker-only.

props.name: popover
props.description: Whether the calendar + time popover exists. `false` makes the field input-only (segmented typing with no popover). Default `true`.

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open the popover on focus. Default `true`.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Off by default — users typically tweak both halves before committing.

props.name: position
props.description: Popover anchor position.

props.name: appendToBody
props.description: Render the popover into `document.body` via portal.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: isRounded
props.description: Rounded input corners.

props.name: shouldDisableDate
props.description: Disable specific dates. Blocked dates are also rejected during manual typing (the predicate receives the full candidate date-time — prefer day-based checks).

props.name: unselectableDates
props.description: Convenience array of disabled dates, matched by calendar day; also rejected by manual typing.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: Day the calendar week starts on.

props.name: dayNames
props.description: Override the 7 day-name labels.

props.name: monthNames
props.description: Override the 12 month-name labels.

props.name: nearbyMonthDays
props.description: Show dimmed dates from adjacent months.

props.name: hourFormat
props.description: Time format.

props.name: enableSeconds
props.description: Show seconds column. Note: iOS Safari's native datetime-local picker UI does not include a seconds wheel; pass `mobileNative={false}` if you need one on iOS.

props.name: incrementHours
props.description: Hour step.

props.name: incrementMinutes
props.description: Step between minute-wheel values (`1` = every minute, iOS-style).

props.name: incrementSeconds
props.description: Step between second-wheel values (only with `enableSeconds`).

props.name: unselectableTimes
props.description: Block specific times. Blocked times are also rejected during manual typing.

props.name: iconLeftName
props.description: Decorative left icon glyph for the wrapping `Control` (shown by default). Set `''` to hide.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Show a clickable launcher button on the right that toggles the popover. Default `true`.

props.name: triggerIconName
props.description: Glyph for the right launcher button.

props.name: audioTick
props.description: Play a short audible tick on each time-wheel crossing. Default `false`.

props.name: haptics
props.description: Auto-route tactile feedback per wheel tick (vibrate on Android, audio thunk on iOS). Default `false`.

props.name: labels
props.description: Optional translatable string overrides.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes.

props.name: ref
props.description: Forwarded to the underlying element.

extraProps.name: form
extraProps.description: Optional id of the form the input belongs to.

extraProps.name: required
extraProps.description: Marks the field as required for native HTML form validation.
